# AgentEnrolScope

`schemas/api/scope/agent-enrol.json`

The scope of agent.enrol (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens", 14 H1): the supervisor actor to create, under an id the client mints (act_…, which must not exist), with its first token. The token is minted by the request layer, never named here; its secret reaches only the live response of the call that applied the enrolment (14 N3). A client retry under the same idempotency key replays without it, and the same actor id under a new key is refused, so an enrolment never happens twice. Only an operator enrols in this build.
